backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing user profiles with access control plus public inquiry submission and admin-only inquiry retrieval.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features to source files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file for build and feature tracking.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles and OKLCH theme variables for light/dark modes with global background and text setup.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry with metadata, Open Graph tags, Google Fonts, and root mount point for the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component assembling the full one‑page site layout with all marketing sections and footer.
frontend/src/components/inquiry/InquiryF: Inquiry form with validation, React Query submission, field-level errors, and success/error states.
frontend/src/components/inquiry/ServiceT: Reusable select component listing available cleaning service types with optional error styling.
frontend/src/components/site/sections/Ab: About section displaying company values, description, and icon-based feature grid.
frontend/src/components/site/sections/Co: Contact section with business info, hours, and an inquiry form.
frontend/src/components/site/sections/Fa: FAQ section rendering common questions in an accordion component.
frontend/src/components/site/sections/He: Hero section with background image, headline, and buttons that scroll to services or contact.
frontend/src/components/site/sections/Lo: Service areas section listing coverage regions with supporting description.
frontend/src/components/site/sections/Pr: Pricing section presenting features and a call-to-action to request a free quote.
frontend/src/components/site/sections/Se: Services section showing a grid of cleaning service offerings with icons and descriptions.
frontend/src/components/site/sections/Te: Renders a testimonials section displaying client reviews with star ratings using static data.
Footer showing copyright text and a caffeine.ai attribution link with dynamic UTM tracking.
Responsive site header with navigation, logo, scroll-based styling, and mobile menu toggle.
Simple layout wrapper that provides a full-height flex column container for child components.
frontend/src/hooks/useActiveSection.ts: Tracks which page section is currently visible using IntersectionObserver and returns its ID.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity, refetching dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, handling login, stored identities, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useSubmitInquiry.ts: Submits formatted inquiry data to the backend and invalidates related queries on success.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and theme variables for light and dark modes with global typography settings.
frontend/src/lib/validation/inquiryValid: Validates inquiry form fields and returns error messages for missing or invalid inputs.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session-based parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending colors, typography, animations, and container settings.
project_state.json: Stores current project configuration, features, and image requirements for building the Bunty Babli website. Includes existing features and pending requests for planning.
